name: VTPass
tagline: Bills payment API for airtime, data, electricity, and cable TV in Nigeria.
description: VTPass provides a REST API for bills payment services in Nigeria, letting developers integrate airtime top-up, mobile data bundles, electricity (PHCN/DISCO) payments, cable TV subscriptions (DSTV/GOTV/Startimes), and education payments (WAEC) directly into their applications. Operated by Broadshift Technologies Limited.
